items.q: Kenny Edison Clarke, Sonny White, Freddy Greene, me, Harry Addison. You know, we all loved her, we all kind of felt very close to her, we'd protect her, you know.

ctx.x: Who else? Well, most of the singers during that time were, you know, but any way, we were talking about Billie. But Jimmie Monroe, he came back and we noticed that Billie had -- we all smoked pot, but Billie had graduated and she just got away from us. Because she kind of like belonged to us or we belonged to her, I don't know. Kenny Edison Clarke, Sonny White, Freddy Greene, me, Harry Addison. You know, we all loved her, we all kind of felt very close to her, we'd protect her, you know.

And she got away from us through this, so everybody hated Jimmie Monroe because of what he had done to her. Then she and Joe Guy got together, he was a trumpet player, as I told you, and I really believe that she started Joe Guy on the heavy stuff, because I saw Joe later, when I told you that
